tools.name: ringkit_create_business
tools.description: Step 1: Create the business. Create a RingKit business (pay-per-minute AI phone receptionist) and its first API key, returned once. No auth needed: this is how an agent starts. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

tools.name: ringkit_whoami
tools.description: Step 1: Create the business. The business behind the API key on this connection, with authKind, role and the key's scope (manage or read).

tools.name: ringkit_get_onboarding
tools.description: Setup progress: the next step (number | done), whether the business has a number, whether the knowledge profile has the basics, and the latest website import.

tools.name: ringkit_start_knowledge_import
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Import the business website into the knowledge profile in the background: returns the queued import; poll ringkit_get_latest_knowledge_import until done or failed. Only fields that are still empty are filled; uploaded documents are never touched. An unfinished import i

tools.name: ringkit_get_latest_knowledge_import
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. The newest website import and its status (queued, running, done, failed), or null when none was started.

tools.name: ringkit_import_knowledge
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Crawl the business website now and draft a knowledge profile (hours, services, FAQs...). Set apply=true to save it, or review and use put/patch. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_start_setup_chat
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Open the setup assistant: a chat that interviews the owner and saves the answers (hours, services, policies, transfers...) into the knowledge profile and routing. Returns the open conversation with the assistant's opening message (restart=true starts over). Capped per

tools.name: ringkit_send_setup_chat
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Send the owner's message to the setup assistant (conversationId from ringkit_start_setup_chat). The reply lists what was saved in `writes`. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_get_setup_chat
tools.description: The open setup-assistant conversation with its messages, or null.

tools.name: ringkit_close_setup_chat
tools.description: Close a setup-assistant conversation (conversationId); what it saved stays saved. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_put_knowledge
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Replace the whole knowledge profile the AI receptionist answers from. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_patch_knowledge
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Update some top-level fields of the knowledge profile (others are kept). Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_get_knowledge
tools.description: Read the knowledge profile the receptionist answers from (services, hours, FAQs, policies).

tools.name: ringkit_upload_knowledge_document
tools.description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Upload a document the receptionist should answer from (menu, price list, policies, manual). contentBase64 is the file's bytes, base64-encoded; fileName's extension picks the type: .pdf, .docx, .txt, .md, .html (PDF/DOCX only where the server has them enabled). tools.name: ringkit_list_knowledge_documents
tools.description: List uploaded knowledge documents (newest first) with usage against the tier's limits.

tools.name: ringkit_get_knowledge_document
tools.description: Read one uploaded document (documentId) with its extracted sections.

tools.name: ringkit_delete_knowledge_document
tools.description: Delete an uploaded knowledge document (by documentId); the receptionist stops using it on the next call. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_get_knowledge_usage
tools.description: Read the knowledge tier (starter | pro), its limits, and how many documents/tokens are used.

tools.name: ringkit_set_knowledge_tier
tools.description: Switch the knowledge tier. pro: 100 documents / 500k tokens for $5.00/month, accrued daily from the wallet (needs $5 of paid credit available; promotional credit doesn't count); starter: free, 5 documents / 50k tokens (refused while usage is over those limits). Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying;

tools.name: ringkit_list_voices
tools.description: Step 3: Pick a voice. List the receptionist voices (id, gender, accent) and the default. Pick one with ringkit_update_business {voice}.

tools.name: ringkit_update_business
tools.description: Step 3: Pick a voice. Update the business: name, timezone, vertical, website, or `voice` (the receptionist's voice, an id from list_voices). Owner identity (ownerEmail, ownerPhone), status and notify need an owner; API keys are owners. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call ex

tools.name: ringkit_get_routing
tools.description: Step 4: Decide who answers. Read the routing policy: when the AI answers, transfers or takes a message, the schedules, transfer targets and spend cap.

tools.name: ringkit_put_routing
tools.description: Step 4: Decide who answers. Set the routing policy: transfer targets (your own team numbers the receptionist can transfer to) and handoff preferences, recording, spend cap. Full replace; omitted fields take defaults. Every call is answered by the AI (mode ai_only): ai_first/human_first are accepted

tools.name: ringkit_get_voice_stack
tools.description: Read which voice stack answers the AI tier: livekit or elevenlabs (the ElevenLabs Agents platform running the same receptionist brain; a caller who needs a person is still transferred to the business's team number or a message is taken). The server chooses the initial stack based on provider availab

tools.name: ringkit_put_voice_stack
tools.description: Switch the voice stack: {stack: livekit | elevenlabs}. Applied synchronously (ElevenLabs agent sync, number import or removal, carrier routing), so it can take a few seconds. Needs an active number and ai_only/ai_first routing (human_first answers 409 voice_stack_unsupported_mode). A failed step ans

tools.name: ringkit_get_wallet
tools.description: Step 6: Fund the wallet. Read the prepaid wallet balance (cents), including the unspent promotional credit (trialCreditCents, calls only), and auto-refill.

tools.name: ringkit_top_up
tools.description: Step 6: Fund the wallet. Add funds (min $10). Returns a checkoutUrl that the human must open and pay (you can't pay), or null when credited immediately (dev). A retried identical call returns the same checkout URL; pass a new idempotencyKey to start a second top-up of the same amount. Identical requ

tools.name: ringkit_get_auto_refill
tools.description: Read the auto-refill settings (enabled, threshold, amount) and whether a card is saved.

tools.name: ringkit_put_auto_refill
tools.description: Step 6: Fund the wallet. Turn auto-refill on or off and set its threshold and amount. It may be enabled before a card is saved; refills start once the human saves one in the dashboard. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_list_ledger
tools.description: Wallet ledger entries (top-ups, call charges, rentals), newest first, paginated.

tools.name: ringkit_search_numbers
tools.description: Step 7: Get a phone number. Search available phone numbers (US, by area code).

tools.name: ringkit_provision_number
tools.description: Step 7: Get a phone number. Order a phone number for the business ($1.99 a month, billed daily from the wallet). Needs $2 of paid credit available (promotional credit covers calls only); no human sign-in. On 402 funding_required call ringkit_top_up, ask the human to pay the checkoutUrl, then retry.

tools.name: ringkit_list_numbers
tools.description: Step 7: Get a phone number. List the business's phone numbers.

tools.name: ringkit_release_number
tools.description: Release a phone number (numberId from list_numbers); it stops taking calls and its rental stops. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_verify_destination
tools.description: Step 8: Place a test call. Call `number` from the business's RingKit number and read a 6-digit code twice (valid 10 minutes), to prove the business controls it. The human who answers must tell you the code for ringkit_confirm_destination. A retried identical call returns the same result; pass a new

tools.name: ringkit_confirm_destination
tools.description: Step 8: Place a test call. Confirm a number with the 6-digit code its verification call read (only the person who answered has it). 5 attempts per code. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_list_destinations
tools.description: Numbers the business proved it controls (allowed test-call targets and ownerPhone).

tools.name: ringkit_test_call
tools.description: Step 8: Place a test call. Ring `to` from the business's RingKit number with the AI receptionist (a real call, billed at the AI rate). `to` must be configured on the business (ownerPhone, a transfer target or an SMS notify target) and verified. Ask the human to answer and talk to it like a caller. A

tools.name: ringkit_list_calls
tools.description: Step 9: Watch the calls. List recent calls with outcome, intent, summary and cost, newest first (paginated).

tools.name: ringkit_get_call
tools.description: Step 9: Watch the calls. One call (callId) with its full transcript.

tools.name: ringkit_get_recording
tools.description: Step 9: Watch the calls. A short-lived URL for a call's recording (callId); 404 when the call has none.

tools.name: ringkit_create_webhook
tools.description: Step 10: Get told about calls. Subscribe a URL to call.completed / message.taken / balance.low events (HMAC-signed with the returned secret, shown once). Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

tools.name: ringkit_list_webhooks
tools.description: Step 10: Get told about calls. List the business's webhook endpoints and their events.

tools.name: ringkit_create_api_key
tools.description: Step 11: Manage API keys. Create an API key: scope manage (acts as owner) or read (read-only tools / GET only). The plaintext apiKey is in this result once and never again. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

tools.name: ringkit_list_api_keys
tools.description: Step 11: Manage API keys. List the business's API keys (prefix, scope, last use, revoked or not); never the plaintext.

tools.name: ringkit_revoke_api_key
tools.description: Step 11: Manage API keys. Revoke an API key (keyId from list_api_keys); it stops authenticating at once, including on this connection if it is this key. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

tools.name: ringkit_invite_owner
tools.description: Step 12: Hand it to the owner. Optional hand-over: emails a sign-in link bound to this business to `email` (default: ownerEmail), adding them as owner first. Nothing in setup needs it: the agent can keep running the line, and the human can take over any time by clicking the link (that sets ownerSign

tools.name: ringkit_get_business
tools.description: Step 12: Hand it to the owner. Read the business: profile, voice, status, how it was created (createdVia) and whether a human owner has signed in (ownerSignedInAt).

tools.name: ringkit_list_business_users
tools.description: Step 12: Hand it to the owner. List the people who can sign in to the business dashboard, with their roles and last sign-in.

tools.name: ringkit_complete_onboarding
tools.description: Step 12: Hand it to the owner. Mark first-run setup finished (the business has a number, or the owner chose to do it later) so the dashboard stops nudging. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ringkit_import_knowledge, ringkit_start_setup_chat, ringkit_get_setup_chat, ringkit_upload_knowledge_document, ringkit_get_routing, ringkit_get_voice_stack, ringkit_top_up, ringkit_get_call, ringkit_get_recording, ringkit_create_webhook · Private data: ringkit_create_business, ringkit_whoami, ringkit_start_knowledge_import, ringkit_upload_knowledge_document, ringkit_list_knowledge_documents, ringkit_get_knowledge_document, ringkit_delete_knowledge_document, ringkit_get_knowledge_usage, ringkit_set_knowledge_tier, ringkit_update_business, ringkit_simulate_call, ringkit_get_wallet, ringkit_top_up, ringkit_put_auto_refill, ringkit_list_ledger, ringkit_provision_number, ringkit_create_webhook, ringkit_create_api_key, ringkit_list_api_keys, ringkit_revoke_api_key · Public sink: ringkit_send_setup_chat, ringkit_upload_knowledge_document, ringkit_update_business, ringkit_test_call, ringkit_create_webhook, ringkit_list_webhooks, ringkit_invite_owner · Destructive: ringkit_delete_knowledge_document, ringkit_complete_onboarding.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ringkit_import_knowledge, ringkit_start_setup_chat, ringkit_get_setup_chat, ringkit_upload_knowledge_document, ringkit_get_routing, ringkit_get_voice_stack, ringkit_top_up, ringkit_get_call, ringkit_get_recording, ringkit_create_webhook · Private data: ringkit_create_business, ringkit_whoami, ringkit_start_knowledge_import, ringkit_upload_knowledge_document, ringkit_list_knowledge_documents, ringkit_get_knowledge_document, ringkit_delete_knowledge_document, ringkit_get_knowledge_usage, ringkit_set_knowledge_tier, ringkit_update_business, ringkit_simulate_call, ringkit_get_wallet, ringkit_top_up, ringkit_put_auto_refill, ringkit_list_ledger, ringkit_provision_number, ringkit_create_webhook, ringkit_create_api_key, ringkit_list_api_keys, ringkit_revoke_api_key · Public sink: ringkit_send_setup_chat, ringkit_upload_knowledge_document, ringkit_update_business, ringkit_test_call, ringkit_create_webhook, ringkit_list_webhooks, ringkit_invite_owner · Destructive: ringkit_delete_knowledge_document, ringkit_complete_onboarding

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
